usage: Used for a very short, breaking-news style update. It is common in media apps, TV tickers, and headlines.
Usually sounds more formal and journalistic than everyday conversation. In daily speech, people often say 即時新聞 or 最新消息 instead.
Can appear as a standalone label in app menus, push notifications, or news sections, often meaning a brief alert rather than a full report.
As a countable noun in context, it can refer to one item of flash news or a short news bulletin; it is not used for ordinary long-form articles.

examples.sentence: 電視台而家出咗一則快訊，話天文台掛咗八號風球。
